messages:
Mina C: quick note from today's design review — users in the lab called out a couple things in Model Catalog: filter button label confusion and performance badges jumping when the left rail toggles.
Omar - UX: ah yeah. the button reads 'Show filters' but when the version-pin modal is open it felt ambiguous. suggestion: 'Open filters' or 'Filters (O)' with tooltip for shortcut.
Rina - Eng: we can change copy easily. Also for badge reflow I can reserve a fixed width and use stable flex so items don't move when the rail animates.
Tom - PM: prioritization: make copy + badge stability low effort. bigger concern is the animation hiding keyboard focus briefly. that failed a VO test.
a11y-bot: issue: prefers-reduced-motion not respected on .catalog-rail transition; contrast borderline on .filter-label (ratio 3.7:1).
Omar - UX: we should honor prefers-reduced-motion and ensure focus ring persists. also add an aria-live="polite" update when a version is pinned so screen readers get explicit feedback.
Rina - Eng: can do reduced-motion flag and aria-live region in one PR. will add tiny JS fallback for older browsers.
Mina C: also want a small visual tweak: badges should have a subtle background to be readable when density increases.
Tom - PM: action items: 1) respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep focus visible (high), 2) aria-live for pin/unpin (high), 3) change button copy to 'Open filters' + tooltip (medium), 4) reserve badge width and add background (low).
Omar - UX: i'll update mock and the accessibility checklist, attach before/after gifs.
Rina - Eng: i'll open PR and tag with 'a11y' and 'ui-bug'.
Mina C: thanks folks — please paste VO repro steps in the PR for QA.
